headline: Developer built ReAct AI pattern before knowing its formal name
summary: The author, familiar with frontend React, encountered "ReAct" in an AI course and realized they had already implemented this Reasoning + Acting pattern in their own project, Verity Lex, without knowing its official name.
details: A developer, already proficient in frontend React, encountered "ReAct" in an AWS AI & ML Scholars course. This new term, ReAct (Reasoning + Acting), initially caused confusion due to its similar spelling to the JavaScript library.

ReAct describes a language model's ability to reason about a task, take actions in an external environment, observe the results, and then use that feedback to continue its reasoning process. This combines previously separate capabilities.

The concept originates from the 2022 research paper "Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models" by Shunyu Yao and collaborators. It explores the power of integrating reasoning and acting for more effective AI agents.

The author experienced déjà vu, realizing they had independently designed and implemented a ReAct-like loop in their own project, Verity Lex. This application needed to dynamically search court websites, observe findings, and decide next steps.

Verity Lex's discovery architecture was built as a "model-directed ReAct loop," allowing the AI to adapt its search based on observed evidence. The author had meticulously designed the system, making deliberate decisions about the model's control.

The irony deepened as the author realized their Next.js application, Verity Lex, used both the frontend React for its interface and the ReAct pattern for its agentic discovery, all within the same project, before understanding the formal name of the latter.
caption:

headline: WhatsApp makes parent-managed accounts easier to set up on iPhone
summary: WhatsApp is bringing its dedicated parental controls section to the iPhone, making the feature easier for parents to find and set up.
details: WhatsApp is rolling out its dedicated parental controls section to iPhone users. This update aims to simplify the process for parents to locate and configure settings for their children's accounts.
